figures.Fig-pie: Pie chart showing distribution of blood types among students. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch22-fig-pie-chart (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).
figures.Fig-line: X-axis data figure showing the effect of temperature on enzyme activity. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch22-fig-line-graph (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).
figures.Fig-error: Graph showing average plant height in different light conditions with error bars. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch22-fig-error-bars (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: Step 3 of the pie chart writes 'Sector angle = Category value/ total value X 100' and puts '%' after degree values; the angles must use x 360, as the book's own working does. 'Surevy' is read as Survey.

The book says the temperatures 5, 10, 20, 30 and 40 C can be evenly spaced because the intervals are similar; they are not equal, and the original graph keeps a true scale, with a note in the lesson, flagged.

The book gives SD about 1 for each plant group; with the chapter's formula (dividing by N = 3) it is about 0.82, and exactly 1 with N - 1. The lesson notes this, flagged. The printed error-bar chart's axis reads 'Axis Title', a placeholder.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
